thesis: The speakers argue that documentation has shifted from being an afterthought for humans to becoming critical operational infrastructure for coding agents and AI tools. They explain that Mintlify was founded by developers who experienced the pain of bad documentation and spent years pivoting through various ideas before settling on a platform that enables builders to learn and build faster.
